// CASE dart_worker_doc_comment_multiline expect=pass
Future<List<R>> a<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = await operation(
        /// it's the "item" with ${await x}
        items[index],
      );
    }
  }));
  return results.cast<R>();
}
// CASE dart_worker_nested_comment_quotes expect=pass
Future<List<R>> b<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = await operation(/* a /* it's */ r" ''' $5 */ items[index]);
    }
  }));
  return results.cast<R>();
}
// CASE dart_worker_spread_single expect=pass
Future<List<List<R>>> c<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<List<R>> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = List<List<R>?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = [...await operation(items[index])];
    }
  }));
  return results.cast<List<R>>();
}
// CASE dart_worker_wrapped_single_control expect=pass
Future<List<List<R>>> d<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<List<R>> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = List<List<R>?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = [await operation(items[index])].first;
    }
  }));
  return results.cast<List<R>>();
}
// CASE dart_worker_spread_dup expect=fire
Future<List<List<R>>> e<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<List<R>> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = List<List<R>?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = [...(await operation(items[index])), ...await operation(items[index])];
    }
  }));
  return results.cast<List<R>>();
}
// CASE dart_inorder_dollar_comment expect=pass
Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T item) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await step(
      item, // costs $5, it's "fine"
    );
  }
}
